review.source: Actual written N1904 and the publisher rows, reviewed against the displayed BSB by Claude (Anthropic); independent peer review recorded in the registry.

2:1.sourceText: Καὶ ἐν τῷ συνπληροῦσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς ἦσαν πάντες ὁμοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό·
2:1.targetText: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

groups.note: ἐν τῷ with the infinitive is a temporal "when".
συνπληροῦσθαι ("was being fulfilled") is rendered came; BSB's Greek text differs slightly in this word, with the same meaning.
ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, "at the same (place)", is rendered in one place.

unmappedSource.reason: The opening καί linking to the previous narrative is not separately expressed.
The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

2:2.sourceText: καὶ ἐγένετο ἄφνω ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἦχος ὥσπερ φερομένης πνοῆς βιαίας καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν ὅλον τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἦσαν καθήμενοι,
2:2.targetText: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

groups.note: φερομένης, "being borne along", is rendered rushing.

unmappedSource.reason: The opening καί linking to the previous verse is not separately expressed.
The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

2:3.sourceText: καὶ ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς διαμεριζόμεναι γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐφ’ ἕνα ἕκαστον αὐτῶν,
2:3.targetText: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

groups.note: ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς, "appeared to them", is recast as They saw.
πυρός, "of fire", is rendered flames of fire.
ἕνα ἕκαστον, "each one", is rendered each.

unmappedSource.reason: The opening καί linking to the previous verse is not separately expressed.

2:4.sourceText: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες Πνεύματος Ἁγίου, καὶ ἤρξαντο λαλεῖν ἑτέραις γλώσσαις καθὼς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐδίδου ἀποφθέγγεσθαι αὐτοῖς.
2:4.targetText: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

groups.note: The genitive Πνεύματος Ἁγίου after ἐπλήσθησαν is rendered with the Holy Spirit.
ἐδίδου … ἀποφθέγγεσθαι, "was giving … to speak out", is rendered enabled.

2:5.targetText: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

2:6.targetText: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.

groups.note: The genitive absolute γενομένης, "having occurred", is rendered when … rang out.
